title.narrative: The EU Emergency Fund for Human Rights Defenders at Risk

description.narrative: The overall objective of this Action is to ensure that human rights defenders (HRDs) at risk around the world receive effective and timely support enabling them to safely continue their work to promote and protect human rights at a local level. To achieve this, the Action will seek to achieve the short-term output of ensuring Effective implementation of the EU Emergency Fund for Human Rights Defenders at Risk by FIDDH and partners. This will support the outcome level medium-term result of Effective delivery of direct material support to human rights defenders at risk through the Emergency Fund, which in turn will feed in to achievement of the overall objective.
